answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 174644 Country: India Title: Doing zikr loudly in the mosque and cause disturbance to others Question: In my mosque after Fajr prayers people sit and do zikr silently. But a person has started doing zikr loudly. This causes disturbance to me. Is it allowed for an individual to do zikr in a mosque loudly? Answer ID: 174644 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 301/250/L=3/1441) It is lawful to do zikr loudly in the mosque or in the outer portion of the mosque. However, doing zikr loudly in a way that causes disturbance for others is not correct. Such person should select such a place in the mosque where others are not disturbed if he does zikr. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
